About Amer

A Developer Who
Built Himself

I'm a front end developer who learned to code entirely on his own — and that taught me that real understanding matters more than credentials. I work with a focus on outcomes: a project that runs correctly, gets delivered on time, and makes the client's life easier.

I care about clean code that doesn't need explaining, and interfaces that feel crafted — not just thrown together. Whether it's a company website, a landing page, or a web app, I bring the same level of seriousness to every project.

The web is always evolving, and that's what keeps it interesting. I stay on top of new technologies and apply what actually serves the project — not what just looks good on a CV.
